title: Amplification Free Paired End Library Construction Protocol
author: Graham J Etherington
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bd3ti8nn
materials: The fragmented molecules were then end repaired in 100 µL volume using the NEB End Repair Module (NEB, Hitchin, UK) incubating the reaction at 22 °C for 00:30:00 .
This is then washed twice with 70% ethanol and the end repaired molecules eluted in 25 µL Nuclease free water (Qiagen, Manchester, UK).
End repaired molecules were then A tailed in 30 µL volume using in the NEB A tailing module (NEB) incubating the reaction at 37 °C for 00:30:00 .

To the A tailed library molecules 1 µL of an appropriate Illumina TruSeq Index adapter (Illumina, San Diego, USA) is added and mixed, then 31 µL of Blunt/ TA ligase (NEB) is added and incubated at 22 °C for 00:10:00 .

Library QC was performed by running a 1 µL aliquot on a High Sensitivity BioAnalyser chip (Agilent, Stockport, UK) and the DNA concentration measured using the High Sensitivity Qubit (Thermo Fisher, Cambridge, UK).

steps.title: Shear DNA
steps.instruction: Shear 600 ng DNA in a total volume of 60 µL using a Covaris S2 (Covaris, MA, USA) for 1 cycle of 40 seconds (00:00:40) with a duty cycle of 5 %, 200 cycles per burst, and intensity setting 3.

steps.title: First bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 58 µL CleanPCR beads (GC Biotech, Alphen aan den Rijn, NL) to the sheared DNA using a positive‑displacement pipette; allow the DNA to precipitate onto the beads.

steps.title: Stop ligation incubation
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL stop‑ligation reagent, then incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Second bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 67 µL CleanPCR beads (GC Biotech) to the reaction and allow the DNA to precipitate onto the beads.

steps.title: Wash and elute DNA
steps.instruction: Wash the bead‑bound DNA twice with 70 % ethanol, then elute the end‑repaired molecules in 100 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Adapter‑dimer removal purifications
steps.instruction: Perform two sequential CleanPCR bead purifications to remove adapter dimers: first add beads at 0.9× the reaction volume, then add beads at 0.6×; finally elute the library in 25 µL Illumina Resuspension Buffer.

steps.title: Library quantification and test run
steps.instruction: Quantify the library using the Kapa qPCR Illumina quantification kit (Kapa Biosystems, London, UK). Run a test lane on a MiSeq at 10 pM with 2 × 300 bp reads to characterise the library before scaling to 60× coverage on a HiSeq 2500 (2 × 250 bp reads).
